# Scott E. Campit, PhD

Personal site for Scott Campit, a computational biologist at TOBY. The site covers AI-based urine tests for early cancer detection, cancer metabolism, and systems biology.

## Root URL

https://scottcampit.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://scottcampit.com/): Bio, role at TOBY, and contact links
- [About](https://scottcampit.com/about/): Current urine VOC cancer detection work and background
- [Publications](https://scottcampit.com/publications/): Peer-reviewed papers
- [Writing](https://scottcampit.com/writing/): Writing index
